info.name: Azure Blob Storage REST Append Blobs Page Blobs API

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Writes a range of pages to a page blob. Pages must be aligned to 512-byte boundaries. The update action writes data to the blob, and the clear action deallocates the specified pages.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Get page ranges

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Returns a list of valid page ranges for a page blob or a snapshot of a page blob.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Get page ranges diff

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

params.name: prevsnapshot
params.description: The snapshot identifier for the previous snapshot.

items.docs: Returns the list of page ranges that differ between a previous snapshot and the current blob or between two snapshots. Useful for incremental backup scenarios.

info.name: Azure Blob Storage Incremental copy blob

params.name: container
params.description: The container name. Must be a valid DNS name, 3 to 63 characters, starting with a letter or number, and containing only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

params.name: blob
params.description: The blob name. Can contain any combination of characters and may include path separators (/) for organizing blobs in a virtual directory hierarchy.

items.docs: Copies a snapshot of a source page blob to a destination page blob. Only the differential changes between the previously copied snapshot and the new snapshot are transferred to the destination.
